source_license: CC BY 4.0; University of Dundee, School of Dentistry; original CT-informed ZBrush Permanent Dentition. This file derives target placement from source geometry.
convention: 4x4 matrices are JSON rows and multiply COLUMN vectors, translation in last column. Use Three.js Matrix4.set(...rows.flat()) (NOT fromArray on those rows). Assembled-native axes: +X patient LEFT, +Y POSTERIOR, +Z SUPERIOR. Raw units from the source including all hierarchy under the outermost Sketchfab_model node. Source-pre-Sketchfab coordinates specifically include all subnode/OBJ transformations but exclude only the outermost Sketchfab_model transform. Apply just ONE appropriate stored matrix to your actual source coordinate basis.
translation_and_scaling: No mesh reshaping: each fit is one uniform similarity. Source right-side is a reflected left source, independently posed to that actual right reference tooth. To bake a matrix with det<0 into vertex positions, reverse triangle winding and update normals/tangent handedness. Avoid duplicated mirroring in runtime. Do not separately recenter either arch because that destroys supplied natural occlusion.
scale_note: UL6 reference world Y span nominally 21 mm; these are not measured specimen units. Use one shared scale for all 28 to preserve arch dimensions.
landmark_method: BBox centers for full exterior; crown landmark = mean of topmost 12% of uniformly area-sampled surface in crownward vertical height; apical landmark = opposite 8%. Mesial/buccal fields follow local arch centerline and are advisory, not clinically annotated anatomical landmarks. Transformed full-reference geometry/registered matrices carry the actual pose.
normalization_note: If canonical mesh is C @ source_pre_sketchfab, use runtime N @ inverse(C) @ canonical for assembled placement; never apply N directly to individually centered/normalized meshes. Same guidance for mesh-local basis and model-wide centered mesh.
